entries.title: Ask HN: As a person, what can I do to improve a city?
entries.author: davidn20
entries.current_title: Ask HN: As a person, what can I do to improve a city?
entries.excerpt: I live in a "Top 10 most dangerous cities in the U.S." What can I do to help? It seems like the most common solution for people who are educated and well off is to move. To get out of the situation, which is understandable. However, this causes a brain drain and leave the city in a worse place. I don't want to do that, I want to uplift if I can. What is the micro thing I can do today, that can have a chance of a macro change tomorrow?
entries.guide_zh: 住在治安问题严重的城市，普通居民能做什么让城市变好？

entries.title: I've now played with a Raspberry Pi 400 for a week and here are my conclusions
entries.author: MarkusWandel
entries.current_title: I've now played with a Raspberry Pi 400 for a week and here are my conclusions
entries.excerpt: My brother gave me a Raspberry 400 (starter kit) because he knew I'd geek out on it and really evaluate it. If you give it fast enough "disk" storage it really moves. I plugged in a Kingston brand 120GB SSD on a USB3 adapter. hdparm -t gave 292MB/s read speed and the default LXDE environment was really crisply responsive, with even a first launch of Chromium taking less than two seconds. entries.guide_zh: 作者使用树莓派 400 一周后分享体验，讨论这台键盘电脑的实际表现。

entries.title: Ask HN: How do custom software dev firms make money?
entries.author: vulpesx2
entries.current_title: Ask HN: How do custom software dev firms make money?
entries.excerpt: Hey HN, I'm working on a project for school and need to learn a bit more about the revenue model of custom software dev firms. I've been googling, but can't seem to get a straight answer. It seems like there's an initial project cost & then maintenance revenue ongoing for the software / app's life. Is that accurate? Appreciate any insight y'all can provide!
entries.guide_zh: 定制软件开发公司如何收费与盈利，发帖者为学校项目了解商业模式。
